newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS END WEAKER, MARKKA SHADE FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS END WEAKER, MARKKA SHADE FIRMER.

text.p: Bonds ended a moderate Friday session weaker but off early lows tracking softer overseas markets with EU leaders efforts to strike a deal on the EMU stability pact commanding centre stage, dealers said.
Eyes would remain on U.S. Treasuries and on Dublin, where EU leaders were in talks on the pact to enforce fiscal discipline after the launch of monetary union, they said.
The Finnish/German yield gap could widen and the markka weaken against the mark unless a deal is reached, dealers said.
"The German mark will strengthen if there is no stability pact," one dealer said.
